title: go to ... go on ... go for ... going
summary: Устойчивые сочетания с **go**: go **to** (место), go **on** (holiday, trip), go **for** (a walk, a swim), go + **-ing** (shopping, swimming), а также **go home** без to.
ru:
## go to + место
Если идём **в/на** какое-то место, после go ставим **to**.
> What time do you usually **go to work**? — Во сколько ты обычно идёшь на работу?
> I'm **going to France** next week. — На следующей неделе я еду во Францию.
> She's **gone to bed**. — Она ушла спать.
> I **went to the dentist** last week. — На прошлой неделе я ходил к стоматологу.
> **go to sleep** — заснуть: I was tired and **went to sleep** quickly.
Важное исключение: **go home** — без to.
- ~~I'm going to home.~~ → I'm going **home**.

## go on + holiday / trip / tour
После **go on** идут слова про поездки и некоторые другие события: **holiday, a trip, a tour, an excursion, a cruise, strike**.
> We're **going on holiday** next week. — На следующей неделе мы едем в отпуск.
> The children **went on a school trip**. — Дети поехали на школьную экскурсию.
> The workers **have gone on strike**. — Рабочие объявили забастовку.
- Сравните: **on** holiday — но **for** a holiday: They've gone to Scotland **for a holiday**.

## go for + прогулка, плавание и т. д.
После **go for** — короткое действие для удовольствия: **a walk, a run, a swim, a drink, a meal**.
> She's **gone for a walk**. — Она пошла гулять.
> Do you **go for a run** every day? — Ты бегаешь каждый день?
> Let's **go out for a meal**. — Давай сходим куда-нибудь поесть.

## go + -ing
Со многими видами спорта и с покупками используем **go + глагол-ing**: **shopping, swimming, fishing, sailing, skiing, jogging**.
> Are you **going shopping** this afternoon? — Ты пойдёшь за покупками днём?
> It's a nice day. Let's **go swimming**. (или: Let's go **for a swim**.)
> I **went jogging** before breakfast. — Я бегал перед завтраком.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I went in the cinema.~~ → I went **to** the cinema.
- ~~We go in holiday.~~ → We go **on** holiday.
- ~~Let's go to walk.~~ → Let's **go for a walk**.
- ~~I go to shopping.~~ → I **go shopping**.
en:
## go to + place
We use **to** when we go to a place.
> What time do you usually **go to work**?
> I'm **going to France** next week.
> She's **gone to bed**.
> I **went to the dentist** last week.
> **go to sleep** = start sleeping.
But: **go home** — no to.
- ~~I'm going to home.~~ → I'm going **home**.

## go on + holiday / trip / tour
We say **go on** holiday, a trip, a tour, an excursion, a cruise, strike.
> We're **going on holiday** next week.
> The children **went on a school trip**.
> The workers **have gone on strike**.
- We say **on** holiday but **for** a holiday: They've gone to Scotland **for a holiday**.

## go for + a walk / a swim ...
We say **go for** a walk, a run, a swim, a drink, a meal.
> She's **gone for a walk**.
> Do you **go for a run** every day?
> Let's **go out for a meal**.

## go + -ing
We use **go + -ing** for many sports and for shopping: **shopping, swimming, fishing, sailing, skiing, jogging**.
> Are you **going shopping** this afternoon?
> It's a nice day. Let's **go swimming**.
> I **went jogging** before breakfast.

## Common mistakes
- ~~We go in holiday.~~ → We go **on** holiday.
- ~~Let's go to walk.~~ → Let's **go for a walk**.
- ~~I go to shopping.~~ → I **go shopping**.
structure:
## Четыре модели
| Модель | Что после | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| go **to** | место | go to school, go to the cinema |
| go **on** | holiday, a trip, a tour, an excursion, a cruise, strike | go on holiday |
| go **for** | a walk, a run, a swim, a drink, a meal | go for a walk |
| go + **-ing** | shopping, swimming, skiing, fishing, sailing, jogging | go swimming |

## Особые случаи
| Выражение | Комментарий |
|---|---|
| go home | без to |
| go to bed | без артикля |
| go to sleep | заснуть |
| go out | выходить (развлекаться) |
| go abroad | без to |

## Формы go
| Форма | Пример |
|---|---|
| go / goes | I go shopping. / She goes skiing. |
| went | We went swimming yesterday. |
| going | He is going to the park. |
| gone | They have gone on holiday. |

## Памятка
> **to** — куда; **on** — поездка; **for** — прогулка/короткое занятие; **-ing** — спорт и покупки.

items.text: Let's go {{for}} a walk in the park.
What time do you go {{to}} work?
Is Ben at home? — No, he's gone {{to}} the gym.
My brother went {{on}} a trip to Kazakhstan.
She went {{for}} a swim in the lake.
